## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck` and the API tests pass (`RUN_DB_TESTS=1 pnpm test` in `apps/api`)
- [ ] Billing, usage or entitlement changes come with tests
- [ ] Docs and `CLAUDE.md` updated where behaviour they describe changed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under Unreleased, with a Breaking subsection if operators must act
- [ ] No personal data of visitors is introduced, stored or logged
